notes.title: Lilith: Rise of the Fallen Demo out now!
notes.content:
LILITH DEMO IS NOW LIVE!


The time has come, sinners.



The Lilith demo is officially live on Steam, and you can now step into the corrupted world we’ve been building for you. Your mission? Survive. Corrupt. Conquer.



Face waves of relentless celestial enemies, harness infernal energy, and twist the world around you to your will. Every second you stay alive, you grow stronger. But beware: the angels won’t rest, and neither should you.


Watch the Trailer now!

[previewyoutube="vibSGX_MU30;full"][/previewyoutube]Why play the demo?
- Test your survival skills in the horde survival system.

-  Experiment with sin upgrades and discover synergies.

-  Feel the pressure of a world constantly trying to cleanse your corruption.

-  Share your feedback and shape Lilith with us before launch.



This is not just a demo. It’s a declaration of war against the Arbiters. Prove yourself now and let the legion taste fear.



🔥 Download the Lilith Demo now and join the chaos. 🔥



We’ll be watching your runs, your strategies, and your triumphs. Share your moments, your clips, your feedback. Let’s make Lilith the game it deserves to be together.



Stay corrupted.

The Flaming Dogs team

notes.title: Let's talk about gameplay!
notes.content:
Let’s talk about what really matters: gameplay.


At the heart of Lilith: Rise Of The Fallen is a system that defines everything: corruption and battlefield control.



Lilith doesn’t just survive the Legion’s hordes — she shapes the world around her.



As you move, you leave behind a trail of corruption, transforming the terrain in real time. This corrupted ground isn’t just visual; it’s your most powerful weapon. The more you corrupt, the stronger you become: skills evolve, cooldowns shrink, and new abilities awaken.





[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45639027/d12ae5da49e1d303f507a6860987f14e753b9beb.png"]






But power invites resistance — your enemies fight back. Celestial forces purify the ground, pushing against your influence. It’s a constant tug of war where territorial control becomes survival, and every decision matters:

Do you spread corruption aggressively to gain momentum?     

Or hold key ground to protect your advantage?



This dynamic loop makes every match unpredictable, strategic, and deeply satisfying — especially for players who thrive on adaptation.



Corruption isn’t just a mechanic — it’s the heart of the chaos.



We’ll be sharing more soon: enemy behavior breakdowns, ability showcases, and deep dives into how terrain affects gameplay in later stages.
